audit_items.proof_trace: Both `calculate_borrow_index` (L118-121) and `accrue_interest` (L139, L146) compute `new_index = simple_interest_factor * old_index + old_index` where `simple_interest_factor = interest_rate * (now - last_updated)`, which equals `old_index * (1 + rate * dt)` — exactly the simple interest formula. All entry points convert the Sui clock to seconds via `timestamp_ms() / 1000` and the interest model stores `base_borrow_rate_per_sec`, so units are consistent. No compound accumulation occurs because `borrow_index_prior` is snapshot before the update and multiplication is applied once per call.
